title: Yellow Roasted Jamaican Coconut Roast
description: A light and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring coconut and clotted cream, perfect for a flexitarian meal. This recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, clotted cream, jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat with the cream mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven safe skillet over medium high heat.
Add the diced yellow bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 25 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
